Text to record: Barka da zuwa Magana. Magana tana karanta shafukan da aka buga da babbar murya: aikin makaranta, alamomin magani, wasiƙu da takardun banki. Ana karanta lambobi daidai yadda aka buga su, kuma Magana tana gaya maka idan wani abu bai bayyana ba. A babban allo, layin sama yana da maɓallan harshe da saituna. A ƙarƙashinsa akwai maɓalli mafi girma: Karanta shafi. A ƙarƙashinsa akwai sauran zaɓuɓɓukanka. A ƙasa gaba ɗaya akwai Riƙe don magana: danna ka riƙe, faɗi abin da kake so, kamar karanta shafi, sannan ka saki. A sauran allo, maɓallin Faɗi suna a ƙasa yana yin haka. Faɗi me zan iya faɗa don jin zaɓuɓɓukan allon. Idan TalkBack ko VoiceOver yana kunne, ja dama don zuwa maɓalli na gaba, ka taɓa sau biyu don zaɓa. Idan a kashe yake, taɓa allon don jin abin da ke ƙarƙashin yatsanka, ka taɓa sau biyu don zaɓa. Don karanta shafi, riƙe wayar a saman sa: Magana za ta gaya maka yadda za ka motsa ta. Za ka iya sake jin wannan rangadin a Saituna.
English meaning: Welcome to Magana. Magana reads printed pages aloud: schoolwork, medicine labels, letters and bank papers. Numbers are read exactly as printed, and Magana tells you when something is unclear. On the home screen, the top line has the language and settings buttons. Below it is the biggest button: Read a page. Under that are your other choices. At the very bottom is Hold to speak: press and hold it, say what you want, like read a page, then let go. On other screens, the Say a name button at the bottom does the same. Say what can I say to hear that screen's choices. With TalkBack or VoiceOver on, swipe right to move to the next button and double tap to choose. With it off, touch the screen to hear what is under your finger, and double tap to choose. To read a page, hold the phone above it: Magana tells you how to move it. You can hear this tour again in Settings.
